## Codebase Architecture Overview

This is an **interactive 3D portfolio website** built with Three.js — a virtual garage where visitors control a voxel robot to explore career stations and personal interests.

### Main Entry Point

**`index.html`** loads ES modules in dependency order, culminating in **`js/main.js`** which orchestrates all initialization.

### Five Most Interconnected Modules

| # | Module | Role | Connections |
|---|--------|------|-------------|
| 1 | **`core/constants.js`** | Configuration hub (dimensions, positions, colors, speeds) | Imported by 23+ modules — every spatial/visual system depends on it |
| 2 | **`core/materials.js`** | Toon material factory for cel-shaded look | Imported by 23+ modules — every 3D entity uses it |
| 3 | **`core/engine.js`** | Three.js renderer, scene, camera, post-processing | Central to all rendering; feeds into loop, controls, minimap |
| 4 | **`core/loop.js`** | Game loop with callback registration | Timing orchestrator — coordinates all per-frame updates |
| 5 | **`systems/collision.js`** | AABB collision detection & boundaries | Bridges controls ↔ entities; every station registers a collision box |

### Data Flow: Input → Core Logic → Output

```
KEYBOARD INPUT (WASD / E / Escape)
       ↓
  controls.js  →  movement vector calculated
       ↓
  collision.js →  validates position against registered boxes + boundaries
       ↓
  robot.position updated  →  camera lerps to follow
       ↓
  station.js   →  proximity check triggers UI prompt
       ↓
  ui.js        →  modal displays content from data/content.js
       ↓
  loop.js      →  each frame calls all registered update callbacks:
                   • robot idle animation
                   • station animations (spinning vinyl, rotating hologram)
                   • dust particles, ceiling fan, minimap
       ↓
  engine.js    →  composer.render() applies post-processing
                   (RenderPass → OutputPass → FXAA)
       ↓
  SCREEN
```

### Key Architectural Patterns

- **Callback registration** — systems register with `addUpdateCallback()` rather than being polled
- **Shared materials** — single `outlineMaterial` instance and gradient maps reused across all entities
- **Merged static geometry** — garage walls/floor use `mergeGeometries` for performance
- **Simple AABB collision** — box checks only, no physics engine
- **Voxel aesthetic** — `BoxGeometry` throughout, keeping triangle counts low

The codebase has ~25 entity modules (stations + props), 6 system modules, and 4 core modules, all wired together through `main.js` which runs a 13-step initialization sequence before starting the game loop.
